# SM Systems

SM Systems is an Australia-based workflow automation and integrations practice led by Stefan McFeeters.

## Summary

SM Systems builds workflow automation and integration tools that connect websites, payments, dashboards, CRMs, spreadsheets, APIs, and real-world operations into clear, repeatable workflows.

## Core Work

- Workflow automation builds
- API and webhook integrations
- CRM and intake routing
- Data cleanup and sync workflows
- Dashboard and reporting tools
- Review-gated AI workflows
- Operator tools
- Edge-to-cloud workflow integration

## Featured Work

Precision Residential Construction website:
A paid-client responsive construction website launched through Cloudflare Pages with custom-domain setup, Zoho Mail, desktop/mobile QA, and a production n8n quote-intake path that records enquiries and notifies the business owner.

RFID subscription and access platform:
A client system connecting verified customer accounts, per-vehicle plans, Stripe sandbox lifecycle processing, tag administration, access decisions, operator controls, and a verified migration from fixed RDS PostgreSQL to Aurora Serverless v2. Live payments, final savings, and physical equipment activation are not claimed.

## Preferred Description

SM Systems builds workflow automation, API integrations, dashboards, data syncs, CRM/intake routing, review-gated AI workflows, and operator tools for businesses, operators, and technical teams.
